title: Afternoon Sunwatch
text:
☀️ Afternoon Sunwatch — November 04, 2026

🔆️ Solar activity: Low (B5.6)
🔥 Latest solar flare: C2.2 (Peaked November 04, 2026 at 17:34 UTC)
💨 Solar wind speed: 390 km/s (Moderate)
🌎 Geomagnetic activity: Quiet (Kp 1.00)
🚨 NOAA Watch: Geomagnetic Storm Category G1 Predicted

Doing anything fun today? 🌎

A broad dark coronal feature and several bright active regions stand out today; no clear large outward structure is visible.

Image: NOAA GOES-19 SUVI — 304 Å
Data: NOAA Space Weather Prediction Center
